findings.text: The provenance probe is `python -c`, which puts the process cwd (the worktree) ahead of PYTHONPATH, so every cpu-base-*.log and rings-head-*.log prints `nova <worktree>/nova/__init__.py` under a header declaring an archive tree. The pytest child does import the declared tree - paired/negative-control.log shows the mutated scratch tree taking effect at 15.716x - so the runs are sound, but the log's own evidence contradicts its header and a promotion guard reading the probe line cannot tell which is true.

The new live_rings closure re-implements the live-ring selection (nonzero, pad, bounded loop) that book.integrate_live_rings already owns at current.py:390; a third copy of one idiom now sits in the module, and the sibling book_tangent at current.py:531 still vmaps over padded rings. A shared helper would serve both and fix the third site.

The added-failure citation is ../../../../../../../../tmp/booking-verify-9VDjGx/head/tests/test_bank_solve_cycle.py, a scratch path the run deleted with its allocation; the durable log is paired/rings-head-test_bank_solve_cycle.log in the run directory, and a later reader cannot follow the citation as written.

The added CPU failure records a largest fresh residual of 1.837e-10 against the brief's 1e-10 budget for every lane; the H200 paired arms meet the budget at 9.818e-11, so the miss is arm-specific, and the worker attributed it to successor bank-solve-breakpoint on this head. It needs that disposition recorded, not folded silently into the promotion.

The per-slice converged wall at 16 slices regressed from 692.879 to 739.054 ms and the whole solve from 11086.072 to 11824.859 ms even though step_jacobian fell from 289.489 to 31.804 ms, because the slowest lane took 12 updates against 10. The node's own step measure improved and the end-to-end measure it reports worsened; section 4 owns the end-to-end target but should not inherit this as a step cost.
